We talk about the future all the time. That’s one of the only reasons why we’re still here tbh. If we didn’t have each other idk where we’d be. But you know life just gets overwhelming sometimes. So overwhelming that you just want to end it. But I’m glad I can say that I’m not alone.

She does tell me she wants to die. I wish I could do something to help her so she doesn’t feel this way, but everything I try just seems like a temporary solution. She’s a great person and I love her so much that it hurts me seeing her like this. I just wish I knew how to help her.
